transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Rinatabart Sesutecan (Rina-S, PRO1184, GEN1184) for Advanced Solid Tumors (GCT1184-01/ PRO1184-001)". Your earlier answers already covered 6 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you previously received any cancer treatments that were known to help your condition?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I've had chemo, Keytruda, docetaxel, and Enhertu. That's three lines of treatment since it got advanced.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you been diagnosed with metastatic or unresectable epithelial ovarian cancer? (Metastatic means the cancer has spread to other parts of the body, and unresectable means it cannot be removed by surgery.)

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have non-small cell lung cancer. It's spread to my adrenal gland and bones, but it's not ovarian cancer.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Has your cancer progressed or grown on scans since your most recent treatment?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, the Keytruda stopped working and the cancer grew. That's why I'm looking at this trial.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you previously received bevacizumab (Avastin) or an approved biosimilar?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had Avastin. My list doesn't mention it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have a known BRCA gene mutation? Also, did you take a PARP inhibitor (like olaparib or niraparib) as maintenance treatment after your platinum chemotherapy?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know about BRCA mutations; it's not on my list. And no, I haven't taken a PARP inhibitor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. You mentioned Keytruda, which is a PD-1 inhibitor. Have you also received prior chemotherapy containing platinum (such as carboplatin or cisplatin)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I had carboplatin. That was part of my first treatment with Keytruda and chemo.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any scans (like CT or MRI) in the last 4 weeks to check if your tumors are still measurable?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, they measure the adrenal tumor every time.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, did your most recent scan (within the last 4 weeks) show that the adrenal tumor is still 'measurable' according to standard RECIST 1.1 criteria? If you aren't sure, that's okay—just let me know.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if it meets the specific RECIST 1.1 criteria. I just know they measure the adrenal tumor every time.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you received all standard cancer treatments that are known to help for your type of cancer, or were you unable to receive them due to health reasons, refusal, or availability?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I've had three lines of treatment: chemo with Keytruda, then docetaxel, and finally Enhertu. I don't know if that covers every standard option available, but those are the ones I've received.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you between 18 and 65 years old?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I'm 69. I'm retired.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with interstitial lung disease (ILD) or pneumonitis (lung inflammation), or had lung issues that required steroid treatment in the last 2 years? If you aren't sure, that's okay—just let me know.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had lung inflammation or scarring.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever received a treatment called a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor-based antibody drug conjugate? This is a specific type of targeted cancer therapy. If you aren't sure, that's okay—just let me know.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had that. My list says Enhertu was my last one.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
